subject: Admin console needs a 'remove from team' action that clears members AND the roster lock
description: Nancy raised this as an accepted risk to track, not a blocker, during the 419/420 review on 2026-09-26. THE BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: ctfJoinTeam's self-heal now repairs a roster lock whose members[] entry is missing. Before that change, this state was a permanent lockout - bad, but INERT. After it, the same state is automatically and silently self-healing. So an instructor who strikes a cheating or no-show student from members[] by hand via the Firestore console, not knowing rosterLocks exists, will find that student quietly restored on their next join attempt. That out-of-band edit is the only known way to produce the state at all: no console 'kick' UI exists, ctfLeaveTeam always clears the lock, and the lock+members write has been atomic since the function was written - which is how the ORIGINAL production drift on Engine 1 Live Fire most likely happened. THE FIX is to make the raw edit unnecessary: an admin console action that removes a member and deletes their rosterLock in one transaction, so intent is expressed through a path the server understands. Until then the self-heal is the right default, because the alternative failure mode (an ordinary student permanently unable to score, with no way to tell) is worse than an instructor's manual removal being undone. Related: Mallory separately proved a stale lock could reattach its holder to a RECREATED team at the same id; that is fixed by recording teamCreatedAt on the lock and comparing it, so the lock now identifies a team rather than an id.
activeForm: Working on: Admin console needs a 'remove from team' action that clears members AND the roster lock
